key_concepts: Plants have roots, stems, leaves, flowers, and fruits.
Roots anchor the plant and absorb water and nutrients from soil.
Stems connect roots and leaves and transport water and nutrients.
Leaves make food through photosynthesis using light, air, and water.
Flowers are the reproductive part and can develop into fruit.
Fruits contain seeds that can grow into new plants.
Plants provide oxygen and fresh air.
Plant roots help prevent floods and soil erosion.
Plants give food, wood, paper, medicine, and other products.
Plants provide shade and shelter for animals.
Some plant parts are used as decorations, wrappers, roofing, and transport.
Plants need care such as watering, fertilizing, and removing weeds.
